subject: Request: brief customer reference & outcomes quote for renewal discussion
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Asha Mehta <asha.mehta@novusretail.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: brief customer reference & outcomes quote for renewal discussion

Hi Asha —

Hope youre doing well. As were preparing for the renewal conversation next quarter, the Redwood renewals team has asked whether Novus would be willing to provide a short reference (1-2 sentences) about outcomes youve seen using the Redwood platform — specifically around latency improvements and cost-per-inference since Q4 rollouts.

Were not looking for anything formal; a sentence or two we can include in an internal case note and a one-paragraph quote for a potential customer-facing one-pager would be perfect. Examples weve collected are: 
- "Reduced 95th percentile latency by 28% during peak traffic"
- "Cut token costs by ~35% via Redwood Optimize batching recommendations"

If helpful, Ive attached a one-pager summarizing Novus outcomes (draft) so you can see context and suggest edits. If youd prefer, Rishi or I can draft a suggested quote for you to edit.

If Novus has procurement or legal concerns, feel free to loop them in — happy to provide approvals language. Wed ideally like to include this in renewal materials by Mar 26.

Thanks so much for considering — appreciate it.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Customer Success Lead, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0126

Attachment: Novus_Q1_Outcomes_OnePager.pdf (summary; editable)

From: Asha Mehta <asha.mehta@novusretail.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Devon Park <devon.park@novusretail.com>, Novus Retail Procurement <procurement@novusretail.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Mar 2026 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: brief customer reference & outcomes quote for renewal discussion

Hi Vanessa —

Thanks for the note and for the one-pager. Novus is happy to be a reference and we can share a short quote. A couple of quick asks from our side:
1) Can you send a suggested sentence we can edit? Were short on time and that helps expedite legal review.
2) Procurement would like confirmation that any quote will be reviewed before public use and that no proprietary numbers will be published without approval.

If you can provide a drafted line and a one-paragraph usage note for approvals, Ill route internally. We aim to respond by Fri the 19th.

Best,
Asha Mehta
VP, Data & Personalization
Novus Retail

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Asha Mehta <asha.mehta@novusretail.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Novus Retail Procurement <procurement@novusretail.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Mar 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: brief customer reference & outcomes quote for renewal discussion

Thanks, Asha — appreciate that. Per your ask, below are two draft options you can edit or shorten; the second is more outcomes-focused and uses numbers drawn from the one-pager we shared (happy to redact if you prefer vaguer language). Also adding suggested approvals language for procurement at the bottom.

Draft A (short):
"Novus Retail improved inference tail latency and reduced per-token costs after onboarding Redwoods Optimize recommendations — enabling faster customer-facing features at lower operating cost."

Draft B (numeric, editable):
"After adopting Redwood Optimize and the dedicated serving profile, Novus reduced 95th percentile latency by ~28% and lowered inference token spend by ~34% across peak-hour traffic, enabling a measurable increase in conversion on recommendation features."

Suggested approvals blurb for procurement/legal:
"Novus Retail grants Redwood permission to use the attached quote for renewal materials and internal sales collateral only. Any public-facing use, marketing, or publication requires prior written approval from Novus Retail legal. Redwood will not disclose raw or proprietary metrics beyond the summarized percentages without additional consent."

If either of those is fine, Rishi and I can incorporate the final wording into the one-pager and produce a redline for legal review. If you prefer, I can also create an anonymized quote (no company name) for press-friendly use.

Thanks — hope this helps expedite.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Customer Success Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachment: Renewal_MA_Plan_v3.xlsx (mutual action plan; editable)

From: Devon Park <devon.park@novusretail.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Asha Mehta <asha.mehta@novusretail.com>
Cc: Novus Retail Procurement <procurement@novusretail.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: brief customer reference & outcomes quote for renewal discussion

Hi all —

Legal/procurement reviewed the suggested language and Novus is fine with Draft B with one small edit: replace "conversion" with "click-through rate on personalized recommendations" and add the clause that any external case study will be routed to Novus for approval prior to publish.

Approved quote (final):
"After adopting Redwood Optimize and the dedicated serving profile, Novus reduced 95th percentile latency by ~28% and lowered inference token spend by ~34% across peak-hour traffic, enabling a measurable increase in click-through rate on personalized recommendations."

Please mark the version as "Novus-approved v1" and send any final one-pager or case study draft to procurement@novusretail.com for signoff. Happy to be a reference for you on the renewal call later this spring.

Thanks —
Devon Park
Principal Product Manager, Novus Retail
